name: 03841 · Hampstead, NH
findings: ZIP 03841 (Hampstead) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03841 (Hampstead) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
